scope_assessment: For Boolean n×n matrices and a given common row order for B, let κ be the total number of maximal one-runs in its columns. Full Boolean multiplication is deterministic in O(n²+nκ) logarithmic-word operations and O((n²+nκ)log(n+2)) bit time. In particular at most n^o(1) runs per column gives near-quadratic time on this subclass.
